summary: Stage 4 parent adjustments, immutable ledger reconciliation, idempotent replay, nonnegative balance and PostgreSQL concurrent debit gates passed.

environment.containerLifecycle: temporary localhost-only container; stopped and removed after the gate

commands.result: H2 PostgreSQL-mode gate passed with adjustment/replay/role/overdraft/reconciliation scenarios; PostgreSQL-only schema and concurrency tests were skipped by environment condition.

commands.command: start temporary PostgreSQL 16 container; set test datasource environment; .\mvnw.cmd -pl family-growth-boot -am test; stop container
commands.result: Six domain tests and six boot tests passed with zero failures/errors/skips. Flyway V1-V3 validated; two concurrent -7.00 debits against 10.00 allowed exactly one success, leaving 3.00 and a balanced ledger.

acceptance.AC4-01: PASS - authenticated parent/own-child wallet and ledger queries are available; family/object scope is enforced by Stage 3 sessions.
acceptance.AC4-02: PASS - parent adjustment requires a nonempty reason and Idempotency-Key and writes Ledger before Wallet in one transaction.
acceptance.AC4-03: PASS - PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE concurrency test allowed one of two conflicting debits and prevented a negative balance.
acceptance.AC4-04: PASS - reconciliation compares summed Money/Coin deltas to Wallet and returned balanced=true; no ledger mutation API exists and database arithmetic/nonnegative/idempotency constraints apply.
acceptance.AC4-05: PASS - H2 isolation and PostgreSQL 16.15 migration/API/concurrency gates passed.
